locations.label: Depot exit
locations.description: Use the starting M14 or Olympia to earn the 750 points needed for the depot exit. Avoid committing to a knife lunge after taking a hit. Open the exit before several windows are overwhelmed; the terminal has too little space to recover from a blocked doorway. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Forecourt Mystery Box
locations.description: Outside, use the MP5 or Remington 870 MCS wall purchase for a weapon with a dependable ammo supply. The Mystery Box sits in the forecourt; take a spin only with a clear approach and enough ammunition to recover from a poor result. There is no upgrade machine to rescue a weak weapon later. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
